experiments.study_type: prostate cancer tumor initiation and metastasis study
experiments.procedure_text: Surgical delivery of Cre/Luciferase lentivirus into the right anterior prostate in Pten loxP/loxP -Trp53 loxP/loxP -Ai9(RCL-tdT) mice to model prostate cancer initiation and distant metastasis.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Surgical delivery of Cre/Luciferase lentivirus (LV-Cre/ Luci) into the right anterior prostate in triple-knockin Pten loxP/loxP -Trp53 loxP/loxP -Ai9(RCL-tdT) mice.
experiments.species_evidence: Pten loxP/loxP , Trp53 loxP/loxP , and wild-type C57BL/6J mice were used in this study.
experiments.test_system_evidence: In vivo and ex-vivo, bioluminescence imaging was performed

endpoints.label: tumor volume quantification
endpoints.evidence: Quantification of the complete volume of the tdT + focal regions

endpoints.label: metastasis analysis
endpoints.evidence: animals of 15 months old for distant metastasis analysis

endpoints.label: nuclear size quantification
endpoints.evidence: Quantification of the increase in nuclear size of tdT + compared to nearby tdT -epithelial cells

endpoints.label: cellular spatial distribution
endpoints.evidence: The distribution of metastatic tdT + cells in the neocortex shows enrichment

substances.name: Luc. Cre lentiviral plasmid
substances.evidence: the Luc. Cre lentiviral plasmid (Tyler Jacks, Addgene plasmid 20905)

substances.name: luciferin
substances.evidence: animals received intraperitoneal injections of 200 mg/kg luciferin

experiments.exposure_evidence: Typically, 20 μL of the concentrated virus was injected into the right anterior prostate.
experiments.notes: The study utilized genetically modified mice for prostate cancer modeling. Animal counts for specific experimental groups are provided in figure legends but not globally specified.
